summary: Max time the load may remain onboard between pickup and delivery.
businessRules: If the route between pickup and delivery exceeds this, the pair is infeasible (C4).

max_time_in_vehicle defines: Use this parameter to limit the drive time for which a shipment stays in the vehicle. The time-in-vehicle calculations start once the pickup leg of shipment is completed after serving any setup and…
Must stay consistent with: shipments.pickup, shipments.delivery. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Values in seconds; must be non-negative. Zero means instantaneous.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: generous max_time_in_vehicle covers the leg.
Infeasible: max_time_in_vehicle smaller than the pickup->delivery travel -> unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: delivery time window earlier than the pickup window -> precedence infeasible -> both unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: two amount [3] shipments onboard together on capacity [5] -> one deferred by capacity.
Interaction: Precedence: pickup [10:00,11:00], delivery [09:00,09:30] (delivery before pickup) -> both unassigned.
